question: After applying the author-documented young-cell naming rule, which T-cell clonal-family fractions reproduce source arithmetic and remain visible under equal mouse sampling depth?
decision: Supersede only the v1 repertoire interpretation; retain all v1 expression/composition outputs. Resolve mouse joins and distinguish source table update differences from biological results.
strongest_rival: Young-cell identifier formatting, cross-mouse clone groups, unequal reconstruction yield and tissue mixture can account for apparent clonal fraction changes.
discriminator: Use the exact author identifier conversion, exact age-specific source-metadata join, within-mouse clone sizes and exact common-depth sampling expectation; retain unmatched rows and paper denominator differences.
exposure_record: descriptive_v1 outcomes and its 2087 failed exact repertoire joins have been seen. The pinned author notebook specifies young-name conversion and within-mouse clone validation. This correction is outcome-exposed and was chosen to repair source matching, not select an effect.
biological_unit: Deposited mouse within each assay and tissue; slash-containing lung IDs are explicitly pooled libraries, excluded from mouse-weighted expression contrasts and composition accounting.
nesting_and_overlap: Repeated tissue and assay samples and the general versus Figure 4 brain objects reuse mice/cells. IDs use different source formats. No cross-organ independence, canonical cross-assay identity resolution or external replication is asserted.
population_and_selection: All Table 9 source reconstructed T-cell rows at 3, 18 and 24 months. Animal-level summaries use only the exact source-metadata matched rows; all unmatched rows remain in audit output.
contrast: Within-source 3,18,24-month descriptive fractions, both pooled matched cells and equal mouse summaries. No hypothesis tests.
endpoint: Reconstructed cells in nonsingleton groups defined jointly by age, mouse and source clone ID; matched/unmatched denominators; exact common-depth hypergeometric expectation; tissue distribution.
methods: At 3m, replace all hyphens in the original T-cell name with periods and append -1-1, exactly as the pinned source notebook. Join to Table 9 metadata cell_name_3m; older ages join unchanged names to cell_name_18m_24m. Require unique keys. Partition source clonal groups by mouse; a singleton after partition is not a nonsingleton clone. Denominator is every matched reconstruction row, including missing clone assignment as singleton. Equal-depth sampling uses the smallest observed reconstruction count across included mice, with exact hypergeometric expected nonsingleton occupancy conditional on observed labels. Preserve original source group_size labels and unmatched rows. Independent Counter verifies every grouped clone size. Export tissue denominators without assuming source mixtures comparable.
missingness_and_exclusions: Unmatched names are exported and excluded only from mouse-level denominators under the source inner-join rule; mismatch does not become missing-at-random. Missing clonal group labels are singleton observations. No receptor sequence is exported or reassembled.
multiplicity: No p-values, significance stars, rankings by effect or confirmatory claims. The fixed descriptive marker family and all contrasts are retained, including null/unfavorable values.
precision_basis: Show every observed mouse and descriptive means; no biological-effect margin, independent unit variance justification or confirmatory power is available.
interpretation_limit: Normalized RNA detection is not senescence, secretion, pathway activation or repair. Source UMAP, cluster occupancy and signature overlap cannot establish trajectory, a distinct intermediate state or AD treatment direction. Clonality is conditional on reconstruction and tissue sampling, not immune performance. Broad shared-age signatures have prior art. No claim promotion.
stop_rule: Stop on nonunique joins or arithmetic disagreement. Retain mismatch with published final-paper counts as a reproduction limitation. Do not reinterpret clonal fraction as receptor function or fit age tests on cells.
amendment_reason: P06-only correction: source notebook establishes an exact young-cell key conversion missing from v1 and validates groups within individual mice. Full expression/composition analysis is not rerun. All prior results and the failed-join audit remain available.
